nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Auto-Tone Discoloration & UV Solution SPF 30

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report mixed results: one found it clogged her pores and left a greasy finish, while another with very oily skin says it was one of the rare sunscreens that did not make her oily or trigger breakouts.
segments.dry: A reviewer with very dry and sensitive skin reports dark spots fading without irritation, and another notes fewer dry patches after weeks of use.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin give mixed reports: some found it left their face greasy after several hours, while others say it does not add oiliness and blends without a white cast.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with rosacea, generally report no irritation alongside fading dark spots, though one cautions that layering it over active serums or moisturizers caused stinging.
segments.mature: A reviewer in her 40s reports valuing the daily SPF and noticing an improvement in her dark spots.

concerns.spots: Many reviewers report a gradual fading of dark spots, post-acne marks, or uneven tone over two to several weeks of consistent use, though several say they noticed no significant change even after weeks of daily application.
concerns.oiliness: Reports are mixed: several reviewers, including some with combination or oily skin, describe the finish as greasy after a few hours, while others, including one with very oily skin, say it did not add shine.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no breakouts or clogged pores and call the formula non-comedogenic, though a couple mention breaking out with use, one attributing it to her own skin sensitivity.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no irritation, including some with rosacea, but one reviewer notes the product can sting or burn when layered over active serums or moisturizers, especially for sensitive skin.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers generally describe the formula as hydrating rather than drying, with a few noting reduced dry patches after regular use.

aspects.libelle: Lightweight formula layers well under makeup
A little product goes a long way
Small tube empties quickly with daily use
Faint scent some find noticeable or unpleasant
No white cast, blends well on deep skin tones

extraits.texte: I tested this product out for about 6-7 weeks and have not noticed much [if any] improvement in my discoloration.

extraits.titre: It's ok just not for me
extraits.texte: I was so excited to try this product when it came in the mail. As a woman with a darker complexion, I struggle to find a sunscreen that doesn't make me look like a ghost. I've been using this sunscreen for a little a week now and never had any ghost effect. Actually it melted into my skin perfectly in less than a minute of massaging. It definitely did a good job with blocking out UV rays. Been out in the sun multiple times for an expended period of time and never got sunburn so that's definitely a plus. However, this product is not ideal for those with oily/acne prone skin. Unfortunately, I do have oily skin and I just end up looking like a glazed donut which clogged my pours. Also, I usually have a skin care routine which consist of both active and inactive ingredients. It seemed to burn/ sting my skin if I combine this product ontop of my serums/ moisturizer, so I would be careful if you have sensitive skin and layering with this product. As far as evening skin tone, I haven't noticed a difference at all. Not even with lightening my dark spots, so I wouldn't expect any major difference in that department. Overall, it's ok. I would recommend this product unless you have sensitive/oily/acne prone skin.

extraits.titre: Good spf but probably better for dry skin
extraits.texte: I like the fact that this spf did not leave a white cast when you put it on. It also does help a bit with discoloration, but I have combo skin and it left my face greasy after several hours.

I got this to replace my usual daily SPF because I like the brand and though the auto-tone aspect was worth trying. I've only been using a week, but I will say, I can already feel an improvement in skin texture. As far as discoloration, I think I'm already seeing slight improvement. I'm very fair and get temporary "scars" (pigment deposits) *very* easily, from every little blemish or anything. These last months, sometimes longer. I also just feel ruddy much of the time. So even after a short time, I do feel there is some improvement, and have high hopes for long-term use. This is maybe a bit heavier than the mineral SPF I previously used, but it isn't making my combo skin feel oily, so not a problem for me.

So I really like this. The packaging is good. I do wear foundation daily so I can't speak on casts but as far as coverage al little goes a long way. It is very lightweight. Didn't make me feel oily and I have VERY oily skin. Most sunscreens make me very oily. This one didn't do that and that is a win! Sunscreens can also break me out and this one did not do that! I highly recommend! I have used several others and this one is a winner!

After using this auto-tone skin discoloration treatment for a few weeks I noticed my post acne scars have lightened significantly in comparison to La roche posay melasma b3 sunscreen. Also found the formula to have a lighter consistency which helps with facial perspiration and does not agitate rosacea.

I have very dry and sensitive skin and was nervous since I've tried other hyperpigmentation products but this is amazing! I really like how I've noticed how the dark spots are fading so nicely and I love that it provides SPF. Definitely recommend.
